arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && cat > t_layout.py <<'PYEOF'
import kit

types = [
    {"name": "I8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "A2", "kind": "array", "element": "I8", "size": 2},
    {"name": "S5", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 5},
    {"name": "ST", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["x", "A2"], ["y", "S5"]]},
    {"name": "AL", "kind": "alias", "target": "ST"},
    {"name": "A0", "kind": "array", "element": "I8", "size": 0},
    {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
    {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b", "c"]},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "I24", "kind": "int", "bits": 24},
]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["p", "AL"], ["q", "A0"], ["e", "E"]],
            "result": ["r", "V"], "requires": None}]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(plan["types"])
for s in plan["slots"]:
    print(s)
print("flag", plan["flag"], "variables", plan["variables"], "modules", plan["modules"])
want_types = ["ST", "AL", "E"]
assert plan["types"] == want_types, plan["types"]
want_slots = [["x2", ["p", "x", 0], 1], ["x3", ["p", "x", 1], 1],
              ["x5", ["p", "y", 0], 1], ["x6", ["p", "y", 1], 1],
              ["x7", ["p", "y", 2], 1], ["x8", ["p", "y", 3], 1],
              ["x9", ["p", "y", 4], 1], ["x11", ["e"], 4]]
assert plan["slots"] == want_slots, plan["slots"]
assert plan["variables"] == 12

leaves = [1, 2, ord("A"), ord("B"), 0, ord("C"), 0, 0]
k = kit.test_ktest(plan, leaves)
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": k}]
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print(out["records"])
print(out["corpus"])
assert out["records"] == [{"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": None}]
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"p": {"x": [1, 2], "y": "AB"}, "q": [], "e": "a"}

# supplying a composite identity must invalidate the run
objs = [["x%d" % i, kit.leaf(w, v)] for (i, (n, p, w)) in
        zip(range(len(plan["slots"])), plan["slots"]) for v in [leaves[i]]]
bad = kit.encode(objs + [("x0", b"\x00")])
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": bad}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

# string buffer identity is also not an object
bad = kit.encode(objs + [("x4", b"\x00")])
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": bad}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

# duplicate object
bad = kit.encode(objs + [("x2", b"\x01")])
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": bad}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

# enum out of range / padded int / trailing bytes
objs2 = list(objs)
objs2[-1] = ("x11", (3).to_bytes(4, "little"))
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs2)}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs, extra=b"\x00")}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs, version=4)}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(objs, magic=b"KTESX")}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": "!!!"}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

# non-canonical names
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode([("x02", b"\x00")] + objs[1:])}]
out, _ = kit.plan_for(campaign)
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST", out["records"]

print("LAYOUT OK")
PYEOF
python3 t_layout.py
